en.title: [KOSAF] Notice on Reform of Student Aid Section Calculation System
summary: The Korea Student Aid Foundation (KOSAF) student aid section calculation system will be reformed starting from the 1st semester of 2027.
The existing 10-tier section system will be changed to a 5-tier system ('Ga' to 'Ma').
Detailed information can be checked on the Korea Student Aid Foundation notice.
en.easyExplanation: Starting from the first semester of 2027, the Korea Student Aid Foundation (KOSAF) student aid section calculation system will be reorganized from a 10-tier system to a 5-tier system ('Ga' to 'Ma'). Students planning to apply for financial aid are advised to check the changes in advance.
en.target: Students subject to student aid section calculation for the 1st semester of 2027 (2027학년도 1학기 학자금 지원구간 산정 대상자)
